finalists.label: Steroid-refractory ICI-induced pneumonitis
finalists.why: The patient's clinical picture and imaging suggested grade 3 ICI-induced pneumonitis, and the lack of improvement with antibiotics and subsequent steroid treatment supports this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Pneumonia
finalists.why: The patient presented with new bilateral infiltrative shadows, fever, and dyspnea, which are common symptoms of pneumonia, but negative cultures and PCR results argue against a typical infectious pneumonia.

finalists.label: Drug-Induced Lung Injury
finalists.why: The patient was treated with ipilimumab and nivolumab, and the follow-up chest CT showed new bilateral infiltrative shadows, which could be indicative of drug-induced lung injury.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of grade 3 ICI-induced pneumonitis and the lack of response to steroid treatment, as well as the temporal relationship between the immunotherapy and the onset of symptoms, decided the final comparison in favor of Steroid-refractory ICI-induced pneumonitis.
